The update channel is baked into the artifact rather than switchable at
runtime: the Tauri updater reads its endpoints from the compiled config, so
a build points at exactly one manifest for its whole life. A writer opts
into previews by installing a preview build, and returns to stable by
installing a stable installer (a stable X.Y.Z always sorts above every
X.Y.Z-preview.N, so it installs cleanly over the top).
productName and identifier stay the same on purpose: a preview is an
upgrade of the same installed application, not a second copy with its own
